hooks.name: Protect env files from writes
hooks.description: Asks for confirmation before writing to .env files to prevent accidental secret exposure

action.command: p=$(jq -r '.parameters.path // .parameters.targetFile // .parameters.filePath // .path // .targetFile // .filePath // empty' 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$p" ] && echo "$p" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This operation targets an .env file which may contain secrets (database URLs, API tokens, credentials). Confirm before proceeding."}}'; fi
